Cuando tu agente haga su primera llamada: When your agent makes its first call, this step turns green. If you would rather connect it later, press «Finish»: it is in Administration → Connect an agent.
De la cuenta de administrador a la prime: From the administrator's account to the first time your agent remembers something, in a few minutes. You can leave at any step: when you come back, it picks up where you left off.
El asistente ya creó un token para este: The wizard already created a token for this brain. You can go on with it, or create another one.
El índice de esta instancia es de {{dim}: This instance's index has {{dim}} dimensions: choose a model of that size. With another one, you will have to reindex.
Choose your agent and copy what it needs. The step turns green when the agent makes its first call; then you can test what it would receive.
Es de solo lectura: tu agente podrá cons: It is read-only: your agent will be able to query it, but not propose anything in it.
Este paso no se puede saltar: al pulsar: This step cannot be skipped: when you press «Next», the server checks it.
Gratis y privado: los textos no salen de: Free and private: the texts never leave your computer. Recommended to start with.
La memoria está lista. Pulsa «Terminar»: The memory is ready. Press «Finish» to go to the home screen.
La memoria se guarda como un grafo: enti: The memory is kept as a graph: entities (people, servers, projects) joined by facts. Here you choose where that graph lives and check that it can be used. If you already have Graphiti data, you can adopt it.
Las propuestas aprobadas esperan sin ent: Approved proposals wait without entering the memory: a language model is needed to extract their entities and facts. Recall keeps working with what is already there.
No responde ninguna de estas direcciones: None of these addresses answers: {{tried}}. Install it from ollama.com, or run the installer again and choose the bundled Ollama.
OpenAI, OpenRouter u otro proveedor, con: OpenAI, OpenRouter or another provider, with its API key.
Para reconocerlo después: el agente o el: To recognise it later: the agent or the team that uses it.
Para una memoria que vas a conservar, un: For a memory you mean to keep, an instruct model of about 14B or more (on Ollama, qwen2.5:14b-instruct) or a small, cheap one from a provider.
Rol Colaborador, válido 90 días. El paso: Contributor role, valid for 90 days. The next step already puts it in what you copy.
Todavía no hay ninguno. Puedes saltar es: There is none yet. You can skip this step, but until you add one approved proposals will not enter the memory, and the home screen will remind you.
Todavía no hay ninguno. Sin decisor, cad: There is none yet. Without a decider, every proposal waits for a curator to review it.
Tu agente se identifica con un token. Co: Your agent identifies itself with a token. With the Contributor role it reads the memory and proposes new facts, which wait for someone to approve them.
Tu agente ya ha hecho su primer recall: Your agent has made its first recall
Un brain es una memoria separada, con su: A brain is a separate memory, with its own graph, members and tokens: for example, one per team or per project.
Un decisor aprueba solo, con un umbral d: A decider approves clearly factual proposals by itself, above a confidence threshold; anything doubtful still waits for a person. It is optional.
Un modelo de embeddings convierte cada t: An embedding model turns each text into numbers so that what is alike in meaning is found, not only what shares words. Without it, recall finds nothing.
Un modelo de lenguaje lee lo que tu agen: A language model reads what your agent proposes and extracts entities and facts from it. Without it, approved proposals wait without entering the memory.
Vuelve al paso anterior y elige un brain: Go back to the previous step and choose a brain.
Ya tienes la cuenta de administrador: co: You already have the administrator's account: with it you set up the instance. In the next steps you get it ready for your agent to remember what it learns.
el de las variables de entorno: the one in the environment variables

{{model}} en {{url}}, {{dim}} dimensione: {{model}} at {{url}}, {{dim}} dimensions. If it already answers, press «Next».
{{model}} responde con {{dim}} dimension: {{model}} answers with {{dim}} dimensions and is already the engine in use.
